title: Saying no, and what instead
sub: Film 3 of Working with people, in Leading data people: when more is asked than a team can do well. Ask what the date is for, put the trade-off where everyone can see it, offer what you can do well, and when, let the people who decide choose, and keep your word.
howto: The film is drawn in ink line, the look of Leading data people: whole people in the places where they live, work and meet, in flat colour with one even dark line, and the film's ideas written by hand, at a board and in notebooks. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans (the dam, and the dates offered and agreed), orange is data (the forecast and the rooms' data), green is something done or kept (the sea that came back, and the dates kept), and amber a cost or a risk (what the sea lost, and the weeks that don't fit).
